name: The Sunk Ward
tagline: PLACEHOLDER: the lowest quarter of Cinderreach.
description: Act 1, The Young Vanguard: the cell fights up from the Sluice Undercroft through the Sunk Ward to the Slag Gate.

warrior.name: Vanguard
warrior.description: Former garrison infantry in dented plate: masters of narrow corridors, shield walls and poise breaks.

rogue.name: Gutter-Stalker
rogue.description: Rooftop couriers and curfew runners: they strike the staggered and the pinned and leave before the Watch arrives.

priest.name: Heretic Acolyte
priest.description: Defrocked scribes and apostate embalmers: battlefield surgery with hot iron and sutures.

ranger.name: Arbalestier
ranger.description: Crag poachers and ridge scouts with winch arbalests and wire snares: they break windups from range.

brawler.name: Slag-Brute
brawler.description: Escaped kiln stokers and foundry breakers: bare hands, shackle cestuses and broken walls; the squad's stagger engine.

mage.name: Ichor Alchemist
mage.description: Tenement hedge chemists and tallow distillers: phosphorus fire, flash-powder and caustic sprays.
